caption: An extreme close-up holds a glossy, translucent orange dome resting on a bed of fine white granules, its wet surface catching a pale crescent highlight near the top and a small bright blob on the right. A fringe of granules already clings to the dome's lower rim. Over the sequence a thin amber liquid appears at the base and spreads laterally into the surrounding granules, darkening and wetting that band while the grains farther out stay dry and white. The lower rim becomes partly obscured by the widening liquid halo, while the wavy boundary remains visible. The specular highlights slowly reshape, the right-side blob stretching into a streak and then splitting into smaller bright marks. A faint pale squiggle on the left shifts slightly in form. The dome remains the dominant mass in the close-up, so the clearest change is the spreading liquid and shifting reflections rather than any large movement of the body.
